dataset.name: Nasreddine dataset
dataset.citation: Z. Nasreddine et al., IEEE Trans. Biomed. Eng., vol. 68, no. 11, pp. 3123-3132, 2021
dataset.availability: UNKNOWN — manuscript says 'multi-center' but does not provide a download URL or access instructions

partitioning.data_leakage_risk: LOW — LOSO ensures no subject overlap between train and test
partitioning.documented_evidence: Section IV.F: 'in each fold we trained the model on data from 21 patients and tested the model on the held-out (22nd) patient'

gaps.notes: No mention of a validation split within each LOSO fold. Unknown how hyperparameters (tau=0.3, decision threshold=0.9362) were tuned. If threshold was selected on test data, this constitutes information leakage.
Decision threshold 0.9362 described as chosen for 'zero false alarms' — unclear if this was selected per-fold or globally. If globally, potential leakage.
Total seizure and normal epoch counts per patient not provided. Only aggregate (67 seizures across 22 patients) stated.
Paper mentions '99% of the normal class' would be discarded in static undersampling, implying ~1:100 imbalance. But exact numbers not stated.
No URL or access procedure for Nasreddine dataset.
